content.value:
Without Prompter, teams create separate OpModes for every configuration — RedLeftAuto, BlueRightAuto, RedCenterPark.

Each combination is another OpMode. Prompter replaces all of them: the driver picks alliance, starting position, and strategy on the Driver Hub before the match, using gamepad buttons and telemetry.

Prompter displays prompts as telemetry. The driver navigates with the D-Pad and confirms with A.

Prompt types:

OptionPrompt — pick one from a list.

BooleanPrompt — yes/no toggle.

MultiOptionPrompt — select multiple items.

ValuePrompt — enter a numeric value.

Prompts can be conditional: .showIf("key", value) hides a prompt unless a previous prompt matches the value.

Results are retrieved in .onComplete(), which runs after all prompts are answered.
Each .prompt(key, prompt) takes a key for retrieving the value and a Prompt. Passing Alliance.class auto-populates all enum constants. Chaining builds the sequence the driver walks through.

prompter
    .prompt("alliance", new OptionPrompt<>("Select Alliance", Alliance.class))
    .prompt("start_pos", new OptionPrompt<>("Start Position", StartPosition.class))
    .prompt("enable_delay", new BooleanPrompt("Enable Start Delay?", false))
        .label("Start Delay")

.showIf("park", true) makes Park Location only appear when the driver answered yes to Enable Parking. The driver won't see it at all if they chose false.

.label() sets a readable name for the summary screen.

.prompt("park", new BooleanPrompt("Enable Parking?", true))
    .prompt("park_location", new OptionPrompt<>("Park Location", 1, 2, 3))
        .label("Park Location")
        .showIf("park", true)

.onComplete() runs once all prompts are finished. Values are guaranteed to be set here.

Use getOrDefault() for prompts that might have been hidden by showIf — it returns the fallback if the prompt was never shown.
In a CommandOpMode, the run() override checks isCompleted(). While prompts are pending, it calls prompter.run() to drive the UI. Once done, it falls through to normal autonomous behavior.

Start the OpMode. Answer the prompts with the D-Pad and A button.

Try: pick no for parking — Park Location is hidden. Restart, pick yes — it appears.

After the last prompt, onComplete fires and all five values appear in telemetry.
